title: AuthFace: Towards Authentic Blind Face Restoration with Face-oriented Generative Diffusion Prior
mask_representation: binary face parsing mask; aligned eye and mouth ROIs
model_injection: the face mask gates Stage-I diffusion noise reconstruction; eye/mouth crops supervise time-aware regional discriminators in Stage II
losses: eye/mouth time-aware latent facial feature loss
data_training: 1.5K professional portraits above 8K for face-prior tuning; FFHQ-derived degraded pairs for restoration
limitations: the paper concentrates on face regions rather than full portrait semantics; numeric regional weights are not all stated in the extracted main text

title: HeadsUp! High-Fidelity Portrait Image Super-Resolution
mask_representation: binary face mask resized to latent resolution
model_injection: LQ latent, optional reference latent and face mask are concatenated into a nine-channel denoiser input
data_training: PortraitSR-4K plus FFHQ, LSDIR and DIV2K; two-stage mixed-data training
limitations: identity loss alone can oversmooth faces; a face-only mask does not separately control hair, clothes and background

title: GeoMAR: Unleashing Geometrically Aligned Features for Masked Autoregressive Blind Face Restoration
institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
mask_representation: semantic facial parsing map plus dynamically masked HQ token sequence
model_injection: RGB and parsing jointly form component descriptions; aligned priors condition a masked-autoregressive transformer
data_training: component-dropout parsing corruptions remove eyes, mouth or facial contour to reduce over-reliance on perfect parsing
limitations: severe occlusion and unreliable parsing remain failure cases; parsing is a soft prior rather than a reconstruction truth

title: BrushNet: A Plug-and-Play Image Inpainting Model with Decomposed Dual-Branch Diffusion
institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
mask_representation: random brush masks and segmentation masks; blurred mask for final blending
model_injection: noisy latent, masked-image latent and resized mask enter a separate trainable branch; zero-convolution features are added layer-by-layer to the frozen UNet
data_training: LAION-5B with random masks; BrushData uses Grounded-SAM masks filtered by confidence and mask plausibility; 430K steps on 8 V100 GPUs
limitations: binary/downsampled boundaries can still be imperfect; preservation scale trades edit strength against source retention

title: A Task Is Worth One Word: Learning with Task Prompts for High-Quality Versatile Image Inpainting
task: inpainting, removal, outpainting and shape-guided synthesis
mask_representation: random masks, bounding-box masks, segmentation masks and randomly expanded masks
model_injection: learnable task prompts Pobj, Pctxt and Pshape specialize one inpainting model; prompt interpolation controls shape adherence near mask boundaries
losses: base diffusion fine-tuning objectives with task-specific prompt training
data_training: Pobj uses object boxes and descriptions; Pctxt uses random masks; Pshape uses segmentation masks expanded by a random ratio
limitations: task-prompt control is semantic and global; it does not by itself guarantee exact preservation of small portrait identity details

title: AnyDoor: Zero-shot Object-level Image Customization
task: object insertion, replacement and local shape editing
mask_representation: target-object segmentation, user location/shape mask and eroded object mask
model_injection: ID tokens and a stitched high-frequency detail map condition diffusion; collage and shape mask provide spatial control
losses: identity/detail conditioning learned from paired views
data_training: same-object image pairs are mined from videos and images; high-frequency details exclude unstable outer contours using an eroded mask
limitations: object-level identity differs from biometric face identity; complex occlusion and source-target geometry mismatch can still fail

title: CosmicMan: A Text-to-Image Foundation Model for Humans
mask_representation: human parsing parts aligned with dense body/clothing descriptions
model_injection: Decomposed-Attention-Refocusing aligns text chunks with body-part regions during training
data_training: CosmicMan-HQ 1.0 contains 6M real human images with 115M multi-granularity attributes; parsing supports region-text alignment
limitations: the work supplies human-generation priors rather than a paired portrait-restoration recipe

title: StableVITON: Learning Semantic Correspondence with Latent Diffusion Model for Virtual Try-On
mask_representation: agnostic person mask/map and dense-pose condition
model_injection: zero cross-attention learns semantic correspondence between clothing features and denoising features
data_training: VITON-HD/DressCode-style person-garment pairs with augmentation that sharpens correspondence attention
limitations: agnostic masking can remove useful body details; garment-person correspondence fails under rare poses or severe occlusion

title: Improving Diffusion Models for Authentic Virtual Try-on in the Wild
mask_representation: garment-agnostic person image, person mask and garment region conditions
model_injection: high-level garment semantics enter cross-attention; low-level garment features from a parallel UNet enter self-attention
losses: paired garment/person conditioning and customization objectives
data_training: person-garment pairs plus detailed person and garment captions; paired customization improves fidelity
limitations: fine garment structure and body occlusion remain sensitive to mask and pose quality

title: Sapiens: Foundation for Human Vision Models
task: human pose, body-part segmentation, depth and normal estimation
mask_representation: human-part semantic segmentation with 28 classes in the reported segmentation task
model_injection: a large human-centric pretrained encoder supplies parsing features; task decoders predict part labels
losses: task-specific dense prediction losses after large-scale masked-model pretraining
data_training: 300M in-the-wild human images for pretraining; human-centric downstream labels for segmentation and geometry
limitations: predicted parsing can be uncertain at hair, accessories and occlusion boundaries and should not be treated as perfect ground truth

title: MatAnyone: Stable Video Matting with Consistent Memory Propagation
mask_representation: continuous alpha matte with memory-conditioned segmentation prior
model_injection: previous-frame memories and current-frame features propagate subject appearance while a region-adaptive mechanism handles boundary detail
data_training: image and video matting data with foreground-background composition and temporal sequences
limitations: long occlusion, fast topology changes and memory contamination remain difficult

title: SynthLight: Portrait Relighting with Diffusion Model by Learning to Re-render Synthetic Faces
mask_representation: foreground/person separation is used in data and relighting construction; lighting is represented by environment maps rather than a binary edit mask
model_injection: input portrait and target environment map condition diffusion; image-conditioned classifier-free guidance balances relighting strength and identity
data_training: synthetic renders from 350 subjects at 512x512 plus real LAION portraits; synthetic:real sampling ratio 0.7:0.3
limitations: limited lighting cues or excessive guidance can under-relight or alter identity; synthetic-to-real distribution drift requires multi-task training

title: COMPOSE: Comprehensive Portrait Shadow Editing
mask_representation: editable lighting decomposition and synthesized shadow layers, controlled by position, size, softness and intensity rather than a single binary face mask
model_injection: four stages: lighting estimation/editing, light diffusion, shadow synthesis and compositing
data_training: 107 subjects, 160-light OLAT capture, 10-20 sessions and 4 cameras; 521 outdoor environment maps generate training lighting
limitations: designed mainly for a single dominant outdoor light; multiple lights and indoor illumination remain open

title: SoftShadow: Leveraging Soft Masks for Penumbra-Aware Shadow Removal
mask_representation: continuous grayscale soft shadow mask: 0 lit, 1 umbra and values in (0,1) for penumbra
model_injection: SAM+LoRA predicts the intermediate soft mask; the removal network receives the shadow image and soft mask and is jointly optimized
losses: penumbra formation constraint on mask gradients
data_training: SRD, ISTD+ and LRSS-style shadow datasets; soft masks are derived from a physical degradation formulation
limitations: the physical approximation can be imperfect for colored/multiple illumination and non-Lambertian effects
